method: Repeat an identical scaled_dot_product_attention call on unchanged BF16 buffers and count distinct bitwise outputs. Batch 128 decode shapes use Q length 1, GQA groups 4, head dim 128 and a fully valid additive mask; batch 256/context 128 and batch 1/context 8192 are the engine's short-context and long-context extremes.
note: cuDNN alternatives differ by about one BF16 ulp (0.001 at these magnitudes) and appear intermittently. torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True does not change the behavior. The memory-efficient kernel returned one bitwise result in every cell.

engine_waves.note: Distinct greedy token hashes across the measured waves of one warmed process.

decision: off by default (EngineConfig.enable_cudnn_attention=False); enable with --enable-cudnn-attention, LFM3_API_ENABLE_CUDNN_ATTENTION=true, or --cudnn-attention in the harness.
